newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Goldman Sachs raises Novartis earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs raises Novartis earnings forecast.

text.p: Goldman Sachs International said it raised its earnings forcast for Novartis AG, the phamaceutical giant to arise from the merger of Ciba-Geigy AG and Sandoz AG.
The change reflects recent divestments and acquisitions, an improved cash situation and the weaker Swiss franc of late.

"Our revised EPS estimates are as follows: 1996 61.6 francs (previously 61.1 francs) or $2.42 per ADR; 1997 82.3 francs (81.6) or $3.24 per ADR; 1998 97.2 francs (95.2) or $3.83 per ADR," it said in a research note issued from London.
Both companies report nine-month 1996 sales tomorrow.
Goldman Sachs forecast Ciba's nine-month sales to rise 4.6 percent to 16.6 billion francs. It saw Sandoz's sales up 7.3 percent to 11.27 billion.

"On a Novartis structure basis, we estimate nine-month sales up eight percent in Swiss franc terms, including strong local currency performances from Healthcare and Agro (+9-9.5 percent) and a gradual recovery in Nutrition," it said.
